comparison.objective: Lock a used needle’s hinged safety sheath one-handed and dispose of the syringe.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware one-handed articulated closure, catch engagement, and protected transfer.
comparison.success_condition: The sheath catch is physically locked, bare-needle proximity rules are respected, and the released syringe reaches the sharps tray.
comparison.reason: Hinged safety-device actuation and sharps disposal are unrelated to screening a bulk mixture through apertures. No material rubric detail is missing.
